title: Sub-Account Voluntary Disconnection (Revoking LPOA) With Zero Trades
precondition: Sub-account linked to MAM group; zero trades open.
steps: 1. Investor clicks 'Revoke LPOA / Disconnect from MAM'.2. Confirm disconnection.
expected_result: Sub-account unlinked cleanly; trading rights restored to client; status set to 'Independent'; manager notified.
actual_result: Voluntary disconnection verified: relationship status set to 'ended', and cleanly re-activated to 'active'.
